name: antics-party-data
title: Antics party data: how groups play party games, 26 August to 4 October 2026
description: Anonymous shares, ratios and medians from parties played on Antics, a pass-the-phone party game app, between 26 August and 4 October 2026: when parties start (UK time), which night of the week is busiest, how many games a party plays, which game comes first, how often Truth or Dare players pick truth or dare, how often each game's cards are skipped, and how long a card stays on screen. Percentages, ratios and medians only. Every figure clears a minimum sample size. The canonical source is https://anticsapp.com/party-data/.

resources.name: antics-party-data-2026-10
resources.title: Every figure on the Antics party data page, 26 August to 4 October 2026
resources.description: One row per published figure. Every value is a share, an index, a ratio or a median; there are no counts. Rows cover 26 August to 4 October 2026 (UK days), except time_on_screen, which covers 6 September to 4 October 2026.

fields.name: section
fields.title: Section
fields.description: Which finding the row belongs to. start_time: share of parties starting in each part of the day, UK time, per hour. night: parties per night of the week as an index (average night = 100), plus the Saturday against Monday to Thursday ratio. games_per_party: share of parties playing one, two, three, or four or more games. games_played: share of parties playing at least one card of each game. games: first game and switching facts. truth_or_dare: truth and dare picks. skips: share of each game's cards on screen under two seconds. time_on_screen: median seconds a card stays on screen, by game.

fields.name: measure
fields.title: Measure
fields.description: What the row measures, in plain words: a part of the day, a night of the week, a game, or a named comparison.

fields.name: value
fields.title: Value
fields.description: The published figure, in the unit given in the unit column. One decimal place for start times, the Saturday ratio, skips and seconds on screen; whole numbers elsewhere.

fields.name: unit
fields.title: Unit
fields.description: What the value is measured in, for example '% of parties', 'index (average night = 100)', 'times as many parties' or 'median seconds'.

fields.name: window
fields.title: Window
fields.description: The UK days the row covers, first and last day included, as 'YYYY-MM-DD to YYYY-MM-DD'.

fields.name: definition
fields.title: Definition
fields.description: The counting rule behind the row, in a few words.
